amendment.idea: The model gives the detail; the level, the colour and the steadiness are set at render time (rudra/genfill/composite.py finish_rerender, neutral_weight, white_scale; rudra/genfill/run.py --rerender-hue/-colour/-level/-smooth). No change to the LoRA, the masks or the contract: inside the mask the SDR codes are not kept, outside it every pixel is the master's.

rules.colour: the fill's luminance with the source's colour (display light blurred 8 px), 0.3 of the model's own mixed in
rules.level: the source-led level (the master's own at tau_high, 3.3 x the master's SDR white at code 253) is a floor; the model's own level above 64 px (at 1080 lines) is kept where brighter, to 2 stops over; detail finer than that is the model's
rules.edges: within 12 px of a darker neighbour the fill is the interior's; a code takes its brightest neighbour's level within 6 px
rules.time: the fill's log luminance keeps 0.8 of the previous frame's where both are filled
rules.scope: the fill acts only where the source is near white in every channel (min over max code from 0.78 to 0.88); a saturated highlight is left to the master
rules.white: the master's SDR white is the median over up to 9 frames of the shot
